Complete 121-token realistic prompt rendered using GGUF chat template, 8-token prefill batches (last batch one token), 128 decode steps, two measured sessions per backend, context 249. Warmup: 8 prompt tokens plus two decode steps.

Candidate uses VulkanDevice::new production selector and verifies CubeClExpanded. Modes run serially in separate processes, generic first. Identical teacher-forced decode inputs; no competing GPU benchmark or build during timing.

Device memory sampled at every batch/token boundary; trajectories match exactly. Live device bytes are constant throughout each 128-token decode and return to post-load bytes after every session. Driver-private pipeline memory is outside allocator counters.

Host anonymous memory counts RssAnon + VmSwap because heavy mmap paging swaps cold anonymous pages. Same 1 MiB allocator-noise allowance; measured growth 24 KiB generic, 8 KiB production. File-backed RSS is separate and grows with weight-page residency.
Harness retains 66,708,480 bytes of reference logits after pass one; bytes are recorded in each sample. Two-pass medians average the middle values.

Despite a complete chat-formatted prompt, the generic continuation is repetitive (repeated 1 tokens), and production reproduces it exactly. This validates long-window/cache parity and measured throughput, but does not establish language quality or broad generated MoE-routing diversity.
